English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fake FactSeeker Confirms Viral Video of Ganemulla Murder Suspect with STF Officers Is AI-Generated False The main suspect in the Ganemulla Sanjeewa murder was arrested by the Special Task Force (STF) on Wednesday (19) evening. Shortly after the arrest, a video began circulating on social media, allegedly showing the suspect laughing and conversing with STF officers. by Anonymous | February 20, 2025 Upon careful analysis of the widely shared footage, several inconsistencies were noted. The vehicle in the video appeared to be moving while the door remained open, and the clarity of the faces and hands was questionable. These anomalies raised doubts about the video’s authenticity. To verify its origins, the video was analyzed using the “Deepware” website, a tool designed to detect AI-generated content. The results confirmed that the video was artificially created using AI. Further investigation revealed that the video was generated using images released by the media on Wednesday (19). Based on these findings, FactSeeker confirms that the viral video depicting the Ganemulla Sanjeewa murder suspect laughing with STF officers was not authentic but rather an AI-generated fabrication. සිංහල | தமிழ் | Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase?
